subject: [hw] P04 -> D01: four [V] facts (VT fallback value; ffmpeg hvcC/avcC field layout on real streams)
body:
For FACTS.md, all verified today on this host; no phone.

[V] 1. kVTVideoEncoderNotAvailableNowErr = -12915, kVTParameterErr = -12902, kVTVideoEncoderMalfunctionErr = -12912: VTErrors.h in gpu/build/apple-toolchain/sdks/iPhoneOS16.5.sdk/System/Library/Frameworks/VideoToolbox.framework/Headers/VTErrors.h:33-50. -12915 is the documented 'encoder not available now' status.

[V] 2. ffmpeg's hvcC for libx265 Main 8-bit 176x144 (avc stream irrelevant) writes: configurationVersion 1; profile_space/tier/profile_idc byte 0x01; compatibility flags 0x60000000; constraint flags 0x900000000000; general_level_idc from the SPS (60 for x265's chosen level 2.0 even when -level 4.1 is requested); min_spatial_segmentation_idc 0; parallelismType 0; chromaFormat 1; bitDepthLuma/ChromaMinus8 0; avgFrameRate 0; constantFrameRate 0; numTemporalLayers 1; temporalIdNested 1; lengthSizeMinusOne 3; three arrays 32/33/34, one NAL each. Evidence: ffmpeg n9.0.2 remux of a raw stream to MP4, extradata read with ffprobe -show_data and cross-checked byte for byte by gpu/hwcodec/vt/test/mp4_extract.py + t_annexb.c.

[V] 3. ffmpeg's avcC for High profile (x264 -profile:v high) appends the four extension bytes after the PPS array: 0xfc|chroma_format_idc, 0xf8|bit_depth_luma_minus8, 0xf8|bit_depth_chroma_minus8, numOfSequenceParameterSetExt=0 (observed fd f8 f8 00); for Baseline it writes no extension. header byte 4 = 0xff (lengthSize 4), byte 5 = 0xe0|numSPS. Evidence: same vectors; gpu/hwcodec/vt/annexb.c reproduces both records exactly.

[V] 4. Remuxing a raw Annex B stream to MP4 with '-c copy' keeps the in-band SPS/PPS/VPS in the key-frame samples (ffmpeg's mdat then contains them); '-bsf:v filter_units=remove_types=7|8' (HEVC 32|33|34) removes them so the sample is extradata-only. This matters for anyone comparing mdat samples against an AVCC converter. Evidence: mp4_extract.py's per-frame sizes before/after the filter on the same 25-frame stream (avc-high 49022 -> 48800 bytes, hevc 48326 -> 47833).
